crossRefs.note: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.
Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty…
The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh’s glory was on the house. They bowed…
He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one…
the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with…
The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.
Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.

translations.web: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the third floor.
translations.bsb: Gallery faced gallery in three levels opposite the twenty cubits that belonged to the inner court and opposite the pavement that belonged to the outer court.
